extracted.name: Girl Scout Cookie Cocktail
extracted.description: A girl scout cookie shot is a vodka cocktail, blended with coffee liqueur, creme de menthe, and Irish cream to taste like the famous Thin Mint cookies.
instruction_lines: Pour vodka, coffee liqueur, creme de menthe, and Irish cream into a cocktail shaker over ice. Cover, and shake until the outside of the shaker has frosted. Strain into a chilled martini glass and garnish with a mint leaf to serve.
